BaselineDiff.description: Summary of a run compared against a baseline report, attached to [`SafetyReport::baseline_diff`] and rendered in every output format.

baseline_tool_version.description: The `tool_version` recorded in the baseline JSON.

fail_on_new_only.description: Whether the verdict was recomputed to consider only new findings.

new_count.description: Count of current findings not present in the baseline.

persisting_count.description: Count of current findings also present in the baseline.

resolved.description: Findings present in the baseline but absent from the current run.

BaselineStatus.description: Whether a finding in the current run was already present in the baseline.

oneOf.description: Not present in the baseline report.
Present in both the baseline and the current run.

BuildMetrics.description: Per-build size and interface-count metrics, carried in the report for all three output formats. These are purely informational and never affect `is_safe`, the exit code, or the recommended bump.

new_enum_count.description: Number of enums in the new spec.

new_error_enum_count.description: Number of error enums in the new spec.

new_function_count.description: Number of exported functions in the new spec.

new_size_bytes.description: Total WASM binary size in bytes for the new build.

new_struct_count.description: Number of structs in the new spec.

new_union_count.description: Number of unions in the new spec.

old_enum_count.description: Number of enums in the old spec.

old_error_enum_count.description: Number of error enums in the old spec.

old_function_count.description: Number of exported functions in the old spec.

old_size_bytes.description: Total WASM binary size in bytes for the old build.

old_struct_count.description: Number of structs in the old spec.

old_union_count.description: Number of unions in the old spec.

size_delta_bytes.description: Byte delta: `new_size_bytes as i64 - old_size_bytes as i64`.

ReportedFinding.description:
A finding as it appears in the report, augmented with suppression state.

The raw [`Finding`] from the diff layer is left untouched; suppression is a report-time concern layered on top. A suppressed finding is still listed in full — it simply does not count toward the failing set.

baseline_status.description: Whether this finding is new or persisting relative to a `--baseline` report. `None` when no baseline was supplied.

classification.description:
How the affected user-defined type was classified (event vs. ordinary storage/interface type), when this finding is about a UDT.

This is *display metadata only*. It never appears in [`Self::category`] and is never part of the suppression key, so a suppression rule keeps matching even if the classification later changes. `None` for findings not tied to a UDT (functions, parameters, environment metadata).

fingerprint.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint computed for this finding.

remediation.description: Optional remediation/explanation advice for the user.

rule_id.description: Stable rule id for this finding.

suppressed.description: Whether a suppression rule acknowledged this finding.

suppression_author.description: The author copied from the matching rule, if it provided one.

suppression_expiry.description: The expiry copied from the matching rule, if it provided one.

suppression_fingerprint.description: The fingerprint copied from the matching rule, if it provided one.

suppression_reason.description: The justification copied from the matching rule, if it provided one.

target.description:
A stable, structured identifier for the exact entity this finding is about, independent of the human-readable `message`. It is the key used by the suppression config to match a finding precisely:

- functions: the function name (e.g. `transfer`) - function parameters: `function.param` (e.g. `transfer.to`) - types (struct/enum removed/added, cascades): the type name (e.g. `Data`) - struct fields: `Type.field` (e.g. `Data.amount`) - enum cases: `Enum.case` (e.g. `Status.Active`)

`None` for findings that are not tied to a single named entity (for example environment-metadata changes).

type_name.description: The name of the affected UDT (struct/enum/union), if this finding relates to a specific type.  Used by cascade-detection so it never needs to re-parse `message`.

ResolvedFinding.description: A finding that was present in the baseline but is absent from the current run — i.e. it appears to have been fixed.

ScopeJson.description: A machine-readable view of an [`AnalysisScope`] for `--format json`.

new_duplicate_names.description: Names of duplicate entries detected in the new WASM (empty when clean).

new_spec_section_count.description: Number of `contractspecv0` sections found in the new WASM.

old_duplicate_names.description: Names of duplicate entries detected in the old WASM (empty when clean).

old_spec_section_count.description: Number of `contractspecv0` sections found in the old WASM.

SeverityCounts.description: Severity counts, serialized as a nested `counts` object.

TypeClass.description:
How a user-defined type is classified for reporting purposes.

This is metadata attached to a [`crate::diff::Finding`]; it never affects the structural category used for suppression matching.

oneOf.description: An ordinary storage or interface type.
A type classified as an event. `heuristic` records *how* it was classified so the report can flag heuristic guesses as such.

heuristic.description: `true` when the classification came from the opt-in name heuristic rather than an explicit `events` entry. Surfaced in the report so a reviewer can tell a guess from a declaration.

UnmatchedSuppressionJson.description: JSON representation of a suppression rule that matched no finding.

description:
A machine-readable view of a [`SafetyReport`] for `--format json`.

Borrows from the owning report. Categories are stored in a [`BTreeMap`] so the emitted JSON has a stable, diffable key order.

baseline_diff.description: Present when `--baseline` was supplied: classifies this run's findings as new/persisting relative to it, and lists resolved ones.

certifies.description: One-sentence bounded claim describing what this verdict certifies. Machine consumers should not equate `is_safe` with storage compatibility.

metrics.description: Build size and interface-count metrics (always present in CLI output).

scope.description: Structured coverage: which analysis dimensions actually ran.

suppressed_count.description: Findings (of any severity) acknowledged by the suppression config.

tool_version.description: This tool's version, so a later run can detect an incompatible baseline before comparing against this report via `--baseline`.

unmatched_suppressions.description: Suppression rules from the config that matched no finding.
